text:
priya-partners: Ok team — kicking off coordination for the South Africa region (za-south-1) with hardware partner SouthNode. Two simultaneous asks: 1) marketplace SKU entitlement + capacity, 2) private VPC onboarding for early enterprise customers. Need KMS/HSM posture confirmed and a press embargo window. cc @tom-cloud @evan-ops :eyes:

tom-cloud: Partner says initial rack ship ETA is late July. Marketplace onboarding form says 4–6 weeks. Practical launch earliest = mid-September. Can we target an internal soft-launch first week Sept? :calendar:

evan-ops: Sounds reasonable. Need SKU names, requested capacity, and whether they want reserved nodes. Can someone paste the partner SKU list? Also will need the marketplace merchant account id.

priya-partners: SKU list from SouthNode attached in their email thread earlier — they use names like SN-1A100-48G and SN-8M80-96G. For the ask start with 8x SN-1A100-48G reserved slots, fallback to mixed GPU pool if quota tight. Merchant account: merchant_za_south_009 (they sent this).

evan-ops: Filing quota request now. Sample payload I'm using for the marketplace ops ticket:
```bash
POST /internal/marketplace/quotas
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "region": "za-south-1",
  "merchant_id": "merchant_za_south_009",
  "skus": ["SN-1A100-48G"],
  "units": 8,
  "reservation_type": "reserved"
}
```
I'll link the ticket when done.

deploy-bot: Created ticket MP-1984: "ZA-south-1 marketplace quota request (merchant_za_south_009)" — assignee: evan-ops, due: 2024-07-10.

nina-legal: Quick heads up on compliance: we'll need the partner MSA, export control questionnaire (they have crypto HSM), and IP/press language for the announcement. If priya can drop the MSA + draft press language by EOD next Tue, legal can turn in 5 business days. Also check South Africa data residency clauses.

jorge-sales: Confirming there are 3 channel partners in Cape Town who want early access (CapeTech SI, GridWave, NimbusZA). They want pricing guidance for reserved vs burst. Can somebody own pricing? :money_with_wings:

priya-partners: I'll own the pricing coord with jorge. Action items: (1) evan -> create quota + merchant entitlements (ticket MP-1984) (2) tom -> marketplace onboarding steps + test listing sandbox (3) nina -> legal review when MSA + press draft in (4) jorge/priya -> go-to-market pricing + SI invites. Also set press embargo date 09-16 for now.

tom-cloud: I'll provision marketplace sandbox and validate listing fields (product description, SKU mapping, billing rules). Expect sandbox readiness by 2024-07-05. Will add deployment checklist: billing_test=true, kms_supported=true, private_vpc_available=true.

evan-ops: MP-1984 updated with SKU mapping and a fallback request for 16 mixed-gpu burst capacity. Linking PRD and partner MSA draft. ETA for infra validation: 7/12.

priya-partners: Good. One more: partner asked about co-marketing / joint announcement. We should lock the embargo and PR approvals before final marketplace listing goes public. Nina — can you confirm legal signoff cadence for PR approvals?

nina-legal: Yep — if we get final PR copy + partner signoff by 2024-08-20, legal can clear in 3 business days. Any deviations (technical claim language) will add time.

jorge-sales: I'll start a short invite list for the beta and coordinate SI pilots. Anyone want to join customer-facing kickoff next Wed 10am SAST?

priya-partners: I'll join. Tom/Evan pls add the sandbox link and MP ticket links to the calendar invite.

deploy-bot: MP-1984 status changed -> in_progress (evan-ops).
